Commentary.Commentary: That is it from us then! The limited-over contests are done and dusted. Over now to the longest format where both sides are relatively new. Who will have the final say? Join us on Friday, March 15, 2019 at 10 am local (0430 GMT) when the only Test is played out. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

William Porterfield credits the team for a quick turnaround. First praises the bowlers for restricting Afghanistan and then the batsmen for chasing the total down, putting a cover on Friday's disappointment. On playing Afghanistan, Porterfield says that they are not alien to Afghanistan, having played them a lot in Dubai and even here. Is looking to put his feet up for a couple of days now and then get ready for the Test match.

ANDY BALBIRNIE HAS BEEN ADJUDGED THE PLAYER OF THE SERIES. 215 runs at an average of 71. Balbirnie says that all the batters were aware of how good the opposition spinners are and if the batters did have a bad day, they used to go back to the nets and work harder. Adds that after the previous game, the Irish watched live video footage of the Afghan bowlers and prepared accordingly. Is looking forward to some rest and then gear up for the exciting Test match on Friday.

Afghanistan captain, Asghar Afghan, says that it was a very good series. Does not want to look too much into this loss as there were plenty of changes to the playing XI. Admits that the top order not firing is a cause of concern but is sure that will be sorted soon. AFGHAN IS ALSO THE MAN OF THE MATCH FOR HIS UNBEATEN 82.

Coming to Afghanistan, they tried hard but probably they tried too hard. This was exactly what Hamid Hassan opined on air too. They were simply rushing through their overs and while it does not give batsmen the time to settle, sometimes it does not allow the bowler himself to relax. The speeds were too quick and there were less changes of pace. Small things but could have made a big difference. The plan to keep Rashid and Mujeeb wicketless or not giving too many wickets worked for Ireland and the hosts struggled for an inspiration. Did Asghar Afghan's absence hamper the home side? You never know. He has more experience of shepherding in close matches. Please stay tuned for the presentation...

There was a brief chance when Simi Singh was dismissed and Ireland needed 56 runs. But the 46-run stand for the 4th wicket between Balbirnie and Kevin O'Brien thwarted all fears. This batting performance is even better than the one in the third ODI. Because it did not rest on just one batsman.

This is what happens when the top order does well. When the original required rate is just a shade over 4, all the team needs is a couple of decent partnerships. The openers added 57 and then Stirling and Balbirnie added 61 for the second wicket which meant that Rashid and Mujeeb were rendered wicketless for a long time.

Given what was witnessed a couple of days ago, everyone must have felt that 217 is a very steep target. That too, on a pitch turning square. But a couple of decent knocks at the top ensured that the run chase was easy.
FOUR! Just one ball needed for Poynter. A full toss, on middle, Stuart gets down and laps it past short fine leg! IRELAND WIN BY 5 WICKETS AND LEVEL THE SERIES 2-2!
Stuart Poynter walks in for the finishing rites.

OUT! BOWLED! Nabi gets a wicket too. Full and outside off, Dockrell initially looks to sweep but then decides to change his shot on seeing the length. Attempts the late guide through third man but misses it totally. The ball spins in and hits the stumps.
Mohammad Nabi to bowl what could be the final over of the series.
Full and around middle, watchfully defended.

SAFE AS A HOUSE. Full and outside off, KOB punched it through point and called for a single initially. Then he saw that the fielder was taking it too lightly and took the second on the throw. The return was a weak one from the fielder and Shahzad had to stretch and then dislodge the bails, which he did very slowly. The run out appeal was referred upstairs but replays confirmed in one go.
Is that a run out now? Shahzad has made a lazy attempt to run Kevin O'Brien out. Referred upstairs...
EDGED, FOUR. Just a hit away from the win now. Full and outside off, O'Brien reaches out to push but gets a thick outside edge past first slip to the third man fence.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Outside off, a play and a miss.
Short and outside off, punched behind point for a couple.
George Dockrell is in the middle.

OUT! BOWLED! Right through the gap. Landed outside off, Balbirnie stays back to defend but the ball lands on that rough patch outside off, spins back in, goes right through the gap between bat and pad and hits the timber! Andy is disappointed with himself that he could not finish it off. But just 10 more needed now. Mujeeb finishes with figures of 10-2-26-1, a decent effort again.
Outside off, punched through the covers for one more.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
Action replay of the previous delivery.
Full and around off, pushed down to long on for a single.

EDGED, DROPPED! Tough chance but Shahzad is not the swiftest of keepers. Full and outside off, Balbirnie looks to drive but gets an outside edge which is clanged by the keeper. He got down but could not quite get up quickly.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman comes back. 9-2-22-0 so far.
Outside off, eased down to long on for a run.
Full and around off, punched back to the bowler.
Full and around off, chipped down to long off for another single.
Short and outside off, crunched through the covers for one more. The stand moves to 40 from 49 balls.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball through mid on. One run added to the total. 200 UP FOR IRELAND. Just 17 more needed now, from 34 balls.
Outside off, played through point for a single.
Last throw of the dice for Afghanistan. Rashid Khan returns. 8-0-28-1 so far.
A length ball, outside off, Kevin looks to pull but misses and is hit high on the thigh. An LBW appeal more in hope than confidence is put up but umpire Ravi calmly denies.

FOUR! TAKE THAT! That is just a hit-me ball. A long hop, around off, happy days for O'Brien as he swivels and pulls it all along the ground behind square leg. The ball races to the fence while Shapoor scratches his head. 19 more needed from 37 balls now. KOB moves to 21 from 31, with his third boundary. The writing is now on the wall.

A full toss outside off, AB throws his bat at that and gets a healthy outside edge which flies through third man. Zahir Khan covers good ground to his left from there, dives, fumbles but stops the boundary and ensures that it is just a single. Shapoor though, is not happy and gives the debutant a scaring stare.
A short ball, around off, Andy mistimes his pull but gets it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Outside off, played straight to point.

Outside off, punched through the covers for a well-run couple. There should never have been two but a weak throw ensured that the single was doubled. Balbirnie moves to 60 from 80 balls. The stand is worth 30 from 41 deliveries.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Full and around middle, chipped down to long on for a run. 29 more needed from 43 balls now.
Full and outside off, Kevin wants to finish this off quickly. Has a mighty swing but gets an inside edge past the leg stump towards short fine leg.
FOUR! SPANKED! Full and outside off, O'Brien smashes it straight back at Balbirnie who ducks in time. There is a long off in place but he comes only second in the race as the ball whizzes past.
ANOTHER WIDE. Second in this over. Fourth from Zahir overall. This is pitched outside leg and spinning a long way down the leg side. Left alone.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
WIDE. Down the leg side, flick shot missed.

FOUR! Lucky escape for O'Brien. A short ball, around leg stump, KOB rocks back to pull but the ball stays extremely low and his bottom hand comes off the bat. He is not in control of his swipe and miscues it aerially towards deep mid-wicket but it is wide of the man running to his left from deep square leg. 36 more needed from 47 balls.
Down the leg side, flicked towards short fine leg for one more.
Outside off, now Balbirnie taps it towards point and takes a quick run.

DIRECT HIT WOULD HAVE HAD O'BRIEN! Shapoor has his hands on his head. Outside off, KOB punches this towards mid off and takes Rashid Khan on. The stand-in Afghan skipper takes his time and then unleashes a throw at the bowler's end but misses. Kevin was a goner.
On a good length outside off, KOB misses his tuck and is hit on the pads, via an inside edge.
A short ball outside off, O'Brien unleashes the mighty heave but misses.
Full and around off, defended from the crease.

DRINKS BREAK. A look at the scorecard and one would say, Ireland are running away with this. But in reality, that is not the case. Batting is certainly not easy out there but Afghanistan are not pitching it in the right areas consistently. The gap between the runs required and the ball remaining is constantly decreasing and if another couple of good overs pass by, we could see a couple of big shots being played, which could open up the game. Change of pace. SHAPOOR ZADRAN returns. 6-0-34-0 so far.
Full and down the leg side, O'Brien misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads towards short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Shorter in length, around middle, punched back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for one.
Full and in line of the stumps, watchfully defended.
Full on middle, pushed back to the bowler who makes a mess of a simple stop and the ball goes through to long on. Easy run conceded.
Full and around off, Balbirnie looks to sweep but gets a top edge which does not carry to deep backward square leg. A single taken.
POWERPLAY 3 time. 5 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end. Zahir Khan is back on as well. 8-0-40-2 so far.
Full and around off, pushed towards mid on.
Full and around off, driven straight to mid off.
Played to the point region by the batsman again.
Around off, pushed towards point.
Full and around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, pushed wide of cover for a run.
Full and around off, watchfully defended, just past Rashid, towards cover.

Huge shout for a catch down the leg side! Turned down. The umpire indicates that it hit the pad. The googly, pitched outside leg, O'Brien missed his flick and the keeper was straightaway up in an appeal after collecting that. Need to see more replays. Age is catching up with me...
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full and outside off, O'Brien lunges to defend but the ball spins away past the outside edge.
Rashid Khan returns. 7-0-27-1 so far.
Pushes this through mid on and gets a run.
NEARLY CHOPPED ON! Things are happening... Outside off, O'Brien goes back to cut but gets a thick inside edge, which hits him on his pads and then bounces just past the stumps!
Around off, defended from the crease.
Outside off, chopped down towards point for one.
That stays low. O'Brien goes back and punches it to long on for a run.
Full and around off, Balbirnie gets down to sweep it through square leg for a single.
Mohammad Nabi is back on. 7-0-37-0 so far.
Outside off, pushed through point for a single.
Goes back in his crease and defends.
Full and outside off, pretty wide, O'Brien winds up for a slog but the ball spins in a long way, takes the inner half of the bat and rolls towards long on. Just a run.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Kevin O'Brien walks in at number 5, replacing Simi Singh.

OUT! Plumb LBW! The change of angle does the trick for Zahir. He had been bowling over the wicket all this while and the first ball he switches the angle, pays him rich dividends. The googly, spinning in slightly, but skidding on mostly, Simi goes back in his crease to work it to the leg side but misses. He is squared up, as he expects the ball to turn away and is hit on the pads. Looks plumb when he is hit on the pads and the umpire agrees. 56 more needed. 7 wickets in hand. 82 balls remaining...
FOUR! Nicely driven. Tossed up, outside off, Simi leans into the drive and gets it through the covers. Javed Ahmadi gives it a good chase from sweeper and dives to his right, but in vain.
Around middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.

HALF CENTURY FOR BALBIRNIE! His 8th in ODIs, 4th vs Afghanistan. He needs to be there till the end at least for Ireland to go through. A composed knock, like Stirling, taking 68 balls, with 4 boundaries.
Full and down the leg side, flicked through square leg for a single.
Balbirnie on 49...
Around middle this time, watchfully blocked out once more.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full and outside off, SS winds up for a big drive but mistimes it towards mid off, who is resting on his heels. A quick single pinched.
WIDE. Spinning down the leg side, Singh misses his flick.
A full toss outside off, Andy misses out, mistiming his drive through the covers for a single.
Outside off, this one comes back in slightly, but is too wide outside off to be played. Left alone.

FOUR! Streaky but Ireland will not mind. Full and outside off, Balbirnie looks to drive but the ball spins away, takes the outside edge and just beats a diving short third man. 150 UP FOR IRELAND. 66 more needed from 95 balls.
Zahir Khan returns. 6-0-27-1 so far.
Pushes this through mid on for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, eased through the covers for a single.
Tossed up nicely outside off, Singh looks to open his arms but can only drive it back to the bowler.
Around off and outside off, Simi dead-bats this one.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Outside off, Balbirnie looks to punch but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.

The leg spinner, pitched on a shorter length, turning away a mile, Simi does not pick it at all and plays it late from the crease. Somehow manages to get it past short third man. Rahmat Shah gives it a good chase from that position, gets to the ball before it touches the  boundary and drags it back in. Three runs taken.
Outside off, the leg spinner this time, SS lunges to defend but misses.
Outside off, the googly, Singh does not pick it and shoulders arms. The ball spins back in and hits him on the pads, prompting an LBW appeal but the umpire stays put.
Full and around middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
The googly, around off, turns in massively, Balbirnie watches it closely till the end and flicks it through square leg for a single.
Gets right behind this one to block.
Full and outside off, Simi lunges to defend but is beaten.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Gets down on a knee and sweeps it through square leg for a single.
The carrom ball, outside off, Balbirnie looks to defend but is beaten as the ball rips away past the outside edge.
Around off, defended from the crease.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman is back on. 6-2-16-0 so far.
Full and outside off, Singh pokes at it and gets a thick outside edge past slip towards third man for a couple.
Full and outside off, spinning away, Simi lunges to defend but misses.
Simi Singh walks in at number 4, replacing Stirling.

OUT! LBW! Oh dear... Stirling does not look happy at all. He has been adjudged LBW. We say adjudged because we think he might have been hard done by. Tossed up around off, Paul made the big mistake of playing this from the crease. Got squared up by the away turn and missed the ball, getting hit on the pads. To the naked eye itself, that looks high but the umpire raises his finger, giving in to the vociferous LBW appeals. Replays confirm that the impact itself was outside off and with the ball turning away... Well, well, well. Do Afghanistan have that door open? Ireland still need 79 from 116 balls. The 81-run stand has been broken.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
WIDE. The googly, down the leg side, Paul misses his flick.
Better from Balbirnie as he comes on the front foot to this one and pushes it to long on for a single.
Full and around middle, that skids through, Balbirnie plays that from the crease and just about manages to keep it out. Risky ploy.
SIX! SMOKED! Nice way to end the over. Full and around off, Stirling gets down and slog sweeps it massively over mid-wicket! Moves to 70 from 86 balls with 7 fours and 2 sixes.
Outside off, chopped down to short third man.
Fetches this from outside off and sweeps it through square leg for one.
Full and around off, pushed through mid on for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Around off, pushed towards long on for a single. 89 more needed from 125 balls.
Full and outside off, Balbirnie looks to drive but misses. Shahzad misses to collect as well and the ball lobs off his thighs over first slip. The batsmen run a bye to third man.
Outside off, pushed towards cover for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Another play and a miss. Full and outside off, Paul lunges to defend but is beaten by the away turn again.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.

Huge shout for caught behind! Not out, says the umpire. Shahzad is flummoxed and wants a review! No UDRS in this series...Here is what the replays show. Full and around off, Stirling stayed back to defend but the ball spun away quickly, in all likelihood missing the outside edge. That is what it seems like to the naked eye. There is a sound heard when the ball passes the bat, perhaps it was hitting the thigh.
Outside off again, this time Paul waits for the ball to come to him and plays this late behind point for one.
Outside off, punched straight to short extra cover.
Around off, watchfully defended with a lunge.
Around middle, Balbirnie uses his long reach, gets to the pitch of the ball with a long stride and sweeps it through square leg for a run.
Full and around off, watchfully defended towards cover.
Landed outside off, Stirling gets well across and punches this down to long on for a single.
Mohammad Nabi returns. 5-0-25-0 so far.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Full and outside off, driven past the man at short extra cover, wide of long off for a run.
Full and around off, this time Paul gets across and defends.
The leg spinner, outside off, Stirling lunges to defend but is beaten comprehensively by the away turn. Mohammad Shahzad behind demolishes the stumps but the batsman never left his crease.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and around off, pushed through mid on for a single.
A short ball, around middle, Balbirnie pulls it towards fine leg for a run.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.
Outside off, tapped towards point for a run.

FOUR! Great shot but poor effort in the field. Fractionally short of a length outside off, Stirling waits for the ball to come to him and then punches it behind point. The ball races away and so does Zahir Khan from third man, to his right. However, he does not put in a dive, trying to kick the ball away but misses it completely.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.

DRINKS BREAK. Mind-blowing. 25 overs have been bowled in around 90 minutes. Excellent batting from Ireland. They have score more than half the runs needed and have lost just a solitary wicket. The pitch does seem to have some turn but is nowhere close to what we saw under the sun. Afghanistan have thrown 20 overs of spin so far - for 84 runs and just one wicket. Another 30 wicketless minutes and this game might be over in the mind.
Around off, defended from the crease.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and outside off, Stirling looks to defend but the ball spins away, takes the outside edge and just escapes slip. A run taken.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
Around off, punched off the back foot towards cover.
Full and outside off, a big googly, spins in, Stirling looks to drive but the ball goes off the inner half of the bat towards square leg. A single taken.
Rashid Khan is back on. 2-0-13-0 so far.

Misfield. Afghanistan slowly running ragged now. Outside off, Balbirnie guides it towards backward point where Zahir Khan gets across to his right from third man and should have cut it off but he takes his eyes off the ball and fumbles. The second is completed with ease.
On a good length outside off, coming in with the angle, Balbirnie defends it watchfully. Shapoor dives to his left but parries it to mid off.
Full and wide outside off, blasted all along the ground but there is a sweeper in place at cover. Just a run.
Fraction short in length, too wide outside off, guided down to third man for a single. 109 more needed from 159 balls.
Outside off, left alone.
On a good length around off, solidly defended.
Outside off, another googly, this time Paul pushes and misses.
Goes back in his crease and works it through mid-wicket for a run. 50-RUN STAND IS UP. So these are two decent stands for Ireland here. Need to just ensure that they do not have a collapse.
The wrong 'un outside off, Balbirnie pushes to defend but misses.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman but straight to the fielder.
Outside off, pushed through point for a couple.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.

FIVE WIDES! A bonus for Ireland. The attempted leg spinner but pitched outside leg. Stirling looks to flick but misses and poor Shahzad behind is blinded. The ball merrily runs down to the fine leg fence. 100 UP FOR IRELAND. 114 more needed from 168 balls.

18TH ODI FIFTY FOR STIRLING, 8th vs Afghanistan. Can tonight's innings come in a winning cause? A calm knock, taking 60 balls, with 6 fours and a maximum. Ireland need another 119 runs and though those might seem easy, given the way the batting has capitulated in this series, Stirling needs to stay till the end. Gets to his half century with a gentle tuck off his hips through square leg for a single.
Full and around off, watchfully blocked out.
Meanwhile, Stirling is on 49...
Outside off, on a fuller length, driven towards point where Najibullah Zadran gets a bad bounce. The ball hits him on the right arm and deflects towards sweeper cover. A run taken.
Fractional fuller, worked through square leg for a single. Moves to 49.
On a good length around off, coming in with the angle, Paul hops and defends it towards cover.
A short ball outside off, Stirling is early into his pull and misses. The ball goes past the bat, hits the arm and then lobs towards point.
Shapoor Zadran is back on. 3-0-21-0 so far.
Looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
Another wrong 'un, this is pitched around off, pushed towards point.
The googly around middle, turning away, defended from the crease.
Balbirnie comes forward and dead-bats it.
Outside off, driven back to the bowler.
Full and around middle, pushed towards long on for a single.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Full and around off, Andy looks to work it to the leg side but gets a leading edge wide of the bowler towards mid off. A run stolen.
Outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Balbirnie goes back and cuts it through point for a boundary again!
The googly, around off, defended from the crease.
FOUR! Outside off, fuller in length, Balbirnie punches it through the covers and gets a boundary!
The batsman has been struck on the pads as he looked to play that off the front foot.
The batsman plays a sweep shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and around middle, swept through square leg for one.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
Brings the sweep shot out and hits it through square leg for a run. The fielder does well to stop it with a slide.
A little too full outside off, AB leans into the stroke and hits it through covers for a run.
Gets away with that one does Rashid. Bowls it short and outside off, Stirling cuts but finds the man at point. A little to the right or the left, it would have surely been two at least.
Gives it a little more air does Rashid and lands it on off, Stirling strokes it nicely but finds cover.
Again goes back and nudges it on the leg side for a single.
On the stumps, Balbirnie goes back and blocks it out. AB seems happy to play Rashid off the back foot.
On the shorter side and outside off, Andy goes back and guides it through point for a couple.
Flatter and on middle, AB goes back and punches it towards mid on. Short mid-wicket gets to his left quickly and saves a run.
Rashid Khan is on now.
The googly but it is shorter in length, Balbirnie has enough time to pick it. He goes back and works it around the corner for an easy run. 5 singles from the over.
Flatter and this one skids through, Stirling just about gets his bat down in time and works it through the leg side for a run.
The leg spinner, Stirling picks it and then works it around the corner for a single.
Brings the sweep shot and plays it nicely through square leg for another single.
This is tossed up on off, Stirling strokes it down to long off and a run is taken.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Down the leg side flicked through square leg for another run.
Full on middle, worked through mid-wicket for one.
Full and around off, watchfully blocked out.
Around middle, watchfully defended.
Full and around off, worked through mid on for a run.
Pushes this through mid on for a single. 149 more needed from 209 balls.
Tossed up outside off, driven straight to cover.
Another LBW shout. Turned down. This is the conventional leg spinner but it is going down the leg side as Andy stays back in his crease to flick and is hit on the pads.
Pitched outside leg, Balbirnie stays back to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. An LBW appeal ensues but nothing in it.
It's been driven superbly through the covers.

FOUR! Full on middle and leg, Balbirnie gets down and sweeps it through square leg for a boundary!
Around off, worked through mid-wicket for one.

OUT! BOWLED! MAIDEN INTERNATIONAL WICKET FOR ZAHIR! This is some ball to begin your international career. The wrong 'un, outside off, SORRY. Well outside off. Porterfield comes half forward to defend but the ball spins back in a long way, beats the inside edge and knocks the off stump back! Porterfield has no idea where that came from. The umpires check upstairs for the no ball but replays deem the debutant fine. The 57-run opening stand is broken and Ireland need another 160 to win from 222 balls.
